catalog_description: Basic aerodynamic phenomena and simplified theory, elementary aerospace vehicle performance, stability and control, and design.
textbooks_and_other_required_material: 1) Dava Newman. Interactive Aerospace Engineering and Design. McGraw-Hill. ISBN. 0-07-234820-8. Primary course textbook.
course_learning_outcomes_expected_perfor: 1) Students should have a basic understanding of various branches of aerospace engineering. | 2) Students should be able to apply their knowledge to various aerospace engineering problems.
class_laboratory_schedule: 3 hours of lecture per week is typical

textbooks_and_other_required_material: 2) John D Anderson Jr. Introduction to Flight. McGraw-Hill. ISBN. 978-981-4636-18-6. Secondary course textbook.
course_learning_outcomes_expected_perfor: 2) Students should be able to apply their knowledge to various aerospace engineering problems.
3) Students should be able to work in teams to complete a project.
4) Students should be able to document their work in a portfolio and present the results of their work.

ice_outcome_1: Comments=Solve problems related to aerospace engineering
ice_outcome_5: Comments=Work together on a group project
